deployments_detail.use: Real-time engine monitoring and engine operation/maintenance optimization combining Kongsberg Vessel Insight data infrastructure with MAN Energy Solutions' PrimeServ Assist engine data-analysis service. Started as a 2-vessel pilot in 2020, expanded to 4 additional vessels in 2021 after successful validation. [Kongsberg Digital + MAN Energy Solutions (PrimeServ Assist)]

AIMMS-based demand planning application that auto-generates and maintains demand forecasts, feeding the integrated business planning tool that optimizes vessel capacity and allocation. Streamlines forecasting for tactical/strategic decisions. [AIMMS (implemented via Districon)]
Kongsberg Digital Vessel Insight vessel-to-cloud data platform for fleet monitoring
Digital trim optimization for engine and operational efficiency in decarbonization roadmap

Fleet-wide vessel-to-cloud data infrastructure (Kongsberg Digital Vessel Insight) that captures and contextualizes sensor/machinery/operational data from vessels, forming the data foundation for performance analytics and AI/ML applications. Höegh was Vessel Insight's first customer (2019); a 2023 contract rolled it out across the entire ~40-vessel fleet and the new Aurora Class newbuilds. [Kongsberg Digital (Vessel Insight)]

Digital Twin and Vessel Performance applications for the maritime fleet. Höegh acted as a pilot customer for Kongsberg Digital, testing Digital Twin technology and vessel-performance monitoring applications built on top of Vessel Insight data. [Kongsberg Digital (Digital Twin / Vessel Performance)]

Global integrated Business Planning System (BPS) built on AIMMS for prescriptive optimization of vessel allocation and fleet composition across trades and loops. Replaced file-based handovers with a single planning database used by planners across 20+ global offices to run scenarios (add/remove vessels, change demand forecasts, restructure trades). [AIMMS (implemented via Districon/ORTEC)]

AI-driven voyage/weather routing and performance optimization for fuel and emissions reduction. Höegh's CEO participated in DeepSea Technologies content/webinars discussing AI performance models and weather routing for alternative-fuel operations; association is documented but a confirmed production rollout of DeepSea (Pythia) across Höegh's fleet is not evidenced. [DeepSea Technologies (Pythia)]

Enterprise AI strategy positioning AI as a 'prediction layer' inside well-engineered systems, applied to customer interactions, voyage management, and cargo/vessel operations to optimize operations, support decision-making, increase safety and minimize emissions. Stated in the 2024 annual report and reiterated by the company in 2026 as an active operational approach relying on real-time vessel data, calibrated sensors and clean data. [none disclosed]
